fields.label: FIPS
fields.description: 5-digit county FIPS code (state + county).

fields.label: County
fields.description: County or county-equivalent name.

fields.label: State
fields.description: State postal abbreviation.

fields.label: Population
fields.description: Total population (ACS B01003).

fields.label: Land area
fields.description: Land area (Census Gazetteer ALAND).

fields.label: Density
fields.description: Residents per km² of land: ACS population ÷ Gazetteer land area.

fields.label: Income
fields.description: Median household income (ACS B19013, inflation-adjusted to the last survey year).

fields.label: Home value
fields.description: Median value of owner-occupied homes (ACS B25077).

fields.label: Poverty
fields.unit: share of people below the poverty line
fields.description: Share of people whose family income in the past 12 months was below the official poverty threshold (ACS B17001 line 2 ÷ line 1; universe: people for whom poverty status is determined, which excludes e.g. people in dorms and institutions).

fields.label: Median age
fields.description: Median age of residents (ACS B01002).

fields.label: Born abroad
fields.unit: share of residents born outside the U.S.
fields.description: Share of residents who are foreign-born (ACS B05012 line 3 ÷ line 1).

fields.label: Degrees
fields.unit: adults 25+ with a bachelor's degree or higher
fields.description: Share of adults aged 25 and over whose highest degree is a bachelor's, master's, professional or doctorate (ACS B15003 lines 22–25 ÷ line 1).

fields.label: Broadband
fields.description: Share of households with a broadband internet subscription of any type, including cellular data plans (ACS B28002 line 4 ÷ line 1).

fields.label: Commute
fields.unit: mean minutes to work, one way
fields.description: Mean one-way travel time to work of workers 16+ who do not work from home (ACS B08013 aggregate minutes ÷ B08303 workers).

fields.label: Homeowners
fields.unit: occupied homes lived in by their owner
fields.description: Homeownership rate: owner-occupied ÷ all occupied housing units (ACS B25003).

fields.label: Uninsured
fields.unit: share of people without health insurance
fields.description: Share of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with no health insurance coverage (ACS B27010, the four 'no coverage' lines across age groups ÷ line 1).

fields.label: Forest
fields.description: Share of the county's land covered by forest (NLCD 41–43), averaged over the hex samples that fall in the county (each hex's share counted once per sample). Null for small counties that no sample hits.

fields.label: Cropland
fields.description: Share of the county's land in cultivated crops (NLCD 82), averaged over the hex samples that fall in the county (each hex's share counted once per sample). Null for small counties that no sample hits.

fields.label: Pasture
fields.description: Share of the county's land in pasture or hay (NLCD 81), averaged over the hex samples that fall in the county (each hex's share counted once per sample). Null for small counties that no sample hits.

fields.label: Built-up
fields.description: Share of the county's land developed at low, medium or high intensity (NLCD 22–24), averaged over the hex samples that fall in the county (each hex's share counted once per sample). Null for small counties that no sample hits.

fields.label: Metro area
fields.description: cities.json id of the metro or micro area the county belongs to (OMB delineation); null if none, or if that area is too small for ACS 1-year data.

fields.label: Map hex
fields.description: A representative US land hex: the one nearest the county's Gazetteer centre point (in its own state where possible). Lets a county smaller than a hex still be found on the map.

fields.label: Faith
fields.description: Religious adherents reported by congregations in the county ÷ 2020 population × 100 (2020 U.S. Religion Census, via ARDA). Can exceed 100 where a congregation draws from neighbouring counties. Counts adherents of congregations where they worship, not residents' beliefs. About half of Americans are counted, and some traditions (notably historically Black churches) are under-reported. 2020 data. Connecticut not shown.

fields.label: Largest tradition
fields.description: The religious tradition with the most adherents in 2020 (evangelical = Evangelical Protestant; mainline = Mainline Protestant; black_protestant = Black Protestant; catholic = Catholic; orthodox = Orthodox Christian; lds = Latter-day Saints; other = Other faiths); null where none were reported. Counts adherents of congregations where they worship, not residents' beliefs. About half of Americans are counted, and some traditions (notably historically Black churches) are under-reported. 2020 data. Connecticut not shown.

fields.label: Wellbeing
fields.description: Health and wellbeing index: 100 − 10 × the mean z-score of the CDC PLACES age-adjusted shares of adults with frequent mental distress, depression, fair or poor health and no leisure-time physical activity (z against all mapped counties). Model-based CDC estimates of adult health, not a happiness survey. No data for Kentucky or Pennsylvania (2025 release).

fields.label: Mental distress
fields.description: Share of adults reporting 14 or more days of poor mental health in the past 30 (CDC PLACES age-adjusted, model-based estimate).

fields.label: Loneliness
fields.description: Share of adults who feel lonely always, usually or sometimes (CDC PLACES age-adjusted, model-based estimate). Not published for several states in the 2025 release.

fields.label: Disasters
fields.description: Distinct FEMA major-disaster (DR) declarations naming the county since 2000-01-01, each disaster once; Biological (COVID-19), emergency and fire-management declarations excluded. A declaration is an administrative act that unlocks federal aid, not a measure of damage.

fields.label: Veterans
fields.description: Civilian veterans aged 18 and over (ACS B21001 line 2).

fields.label: Veterans share
fields.description: Veterans among the civilian population aged 18 and over (ACS B21001 line 2 ÷ line 1).

fields.label: Armed forces
fields.description: Residents aged 16 and over on active duty in the armed forces, counted where they live (ACS B23025 line 6).

fields.label: Armed forces share
fields.description: Active-duty armed forces among residents aged 16 and over (ACS B23025 line 6 ÷ line 1).
